features.summary: AGENT_PROMPTS.md §3 (Implementation Agent — Backend) carries a 'Within-stage iteration loop' block: bounded N=3 inner-iteration cap, pass-criteria sourced from {plan_json} with fallback to profile gate-suite + zero-P0 self-review, per-iteration impl_iteration metric emission, and verdict halt --reason iteration-exhausted on exhaustion.

pass_criteria.pattern: no plan.json — falling back to prose plan

features.summary: bin/dispatch.sh::allowed_tools_for grants the implementing stage Bash(bash .pipeline/bin/metrics.sh:*) AND Bash(bash bin/metrics.sh:*) via the dual-path pattern already used for linear.sh / pipeline.sh in the same arm.

bin/agent-prompts-content-test.sh asserts §3 contains the iteration-loop block: heading literal, cap literal 3, metric chokepoint literal, pass_criteria token, fallback marker, and verdict-halt reason. Existing §3 assertions stay green.
bin/dispatch-test.sh asserts the implementing stage carries BOTH metrics.sh path variants (.pipeline/bin/metrics.sh + bin/metrics.sh) — mirrors the existing dual-path assertion for linear.sh.
bin/metrics-test.sh asserts the free-form impl_iteration event lands a well-formed JSONL row with the expected fields (event/outcome/notes carrying iteration ordinal).
Existing gate suite remains green post-change: the full pre-commit-equivalent shell-test surface listed in the project profile's Build & test gates section passes.
